name: Orenhofen (Germany)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly, blue above and white below, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Orenhofen (an arrowhead on white above a rose on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Orenhofen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
